checkpoint.title: New game to the station platform

events.why: step 0: on the HOME screen with PLZA's tile selected: close it if it is running (X, A), launch the selected tile without moving the cursor, user select / license check, wait for the language list (no save: a new game opens on it)
step 1: on the language list, move the highlight to the run's language (English) and press A
steps 3-4: name the player and confirm
step 5: the opening cutscene, no presses (A does not advance it), until the autosave badge has shown and the station platform holds

metadata.source: console B recording, 2026-11-08/09: played step by step from a new game
